answer: The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in ferrous, expire in whisper, and lagoon lists each expiry. An adversary running 12 aliases hence needs 19 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1094 identities would post 3846 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
